description: This bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," illustrates the number of factual errors made by three different question-answering systems—NoR QA (orange with grid pattern), OneR QA (red with dot pattern), and IRCt QA (blue with diagonal stripes)—across four distinct datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in the order presented, while the vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, scaled linearly from 0 to 35 with tick marks at intervals of 5. Each dataset has three adjacent bars, one for each system, with the exact error count labeled above each bar. For HotpotQA, the systems recorded 15, 10, and 1 errors respectively. For 2WikiMQA, the values were 29, 23, and 14. For MuSiQue, the values were 28, 27, and 23. For IIRC, the values were 15, 14, and 11. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the datasets. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner identifying each system by its color and pattern.
